title: Cinematic Monochrome Portrait
prompt: Create a highly realistic cinematic black-and-white editorial portrait of a young man seated and leaning slightly forward toward the camera in a dark minimalist studio. Composition: vertical 4:5 portrait framing, close-up to medium portrait, subject centered, camera positioned slightly above eye level. His upper body fills most of the frame. He leans forward with his face close to the camera, creating an intense and dramatic perspective. Pose: the man is seated in a relaxed but powerful posture, shoulders slightly forward. One hand is raised naturally in front of his chest and face, with the fingers loosely separated and partially overlapping the lower part of the portrait. His other arm is relaxed. A classic metal wristwatch with a dark strap is clearly visible on the raised wrist. Expression: serious, calm and intense, looking directly into the camera with a focused gaze. Neutral lips, relaxed facial muscles, slightly lowered eyebrows, mysterious editorial mood. Face: youthful masculine facial structure, defined cheekbones and jawline, straight nose, natural lips, realistic skin texture and subtle facial imperfections. Strong natural facial shadows.
howToUse: Use 4:5 aspect ratio with high contrast black-and-white styling. Focus on natural skin texture, hands in foreground, and sharp metallic reflections on the wristwatch.
cameraSettings: 85mm f/1.8 prime lens, 1/200s, ISO 100, single key light
lighting: Chiaroscuro high-contrast studio softbox with deep dramatic shadows

title: Beach Mirror Reflection Romance
prompt: Photorealistic romantic couple photo, creative mirror reflection concept. Foreground: coarse beach sand in focus, a round vintage mirror with golden frame lying on sand. In the mirror's reflection: a young couple hugging on the beach at blue hour. Guy: curly black hair, light mustache, wearing black and beige tribal printed half-sleeve shirt, light beige pants, black watch, smiling looking away. Girl: long black hair, eyes closed, wearing magenta pink saree / crop top and draped skirt, hugging guy. Background outside mirror: blurred beach sand, ocean waves, palm trees, twilight blue sky. Ultra HD, sharp focus on mirror reflection, shallow depth of field, dreamy romantic aesthetic, cinematic lighting.
howToUse: Frame the shot with sharp focus on the vintage golden mirror in the sandy foreground, letting the romantic couple embrace inside the reflection at twilight blue hour.
cameraSettings: 50mm f/1.4, 1/250s, ISO 200, shallow depth of field
lighting: Golden hour twilight transition with soft twilight ocean bounce

title: Luxury Ivory Suit Editorial
prompt: Create a sophisticated, premium 4:6 vertical luxury-fashion studio photoshoot of me. STRICT IDENTITY: Use my uploaded reference image only to preserve my exact facial features, beard and natural skin tone. Completely replace the original clothing, hairstyle, pose and expression. Maintain a natural, lean build with realistic 5'6" proportions. Costume: Dress me in a tailored ivory double-breasted suit with a dark-burgundy silk shirt, a slim leather belt, polished brown leather loafers, an elegant wristwatch and a pair of black sunglasses held in one hand. Give me a neat, sophisticated, swept-back hairstyle with natural volume. Capture me sitting backward on a luxurious burgundy velvet chair, with my arms resting casually across the chair's backrest and my body turned slightly toward the camera. My face shows a genuine, spontaneous burst of laughter, with my mouth open, teeth naturally visible, eyes slightly narrowed and my head tilted a little to one side. Use a deep-burgundy studio background with a large, soft circular spotlight behind the chair, creating a dramatic halo effect and rich depth of field. Warm rim lighting to accentuate the shoulders and silhouette. Editorial luxury-fashion lighting, medium shot, Canon EOS R5 style, sharp focus, 8k resolution.
howToUse: Combine with an image reference of yourself for exact facial likeness. The prompt replaces clothes with an ivory double-breasted suit and sets up a rich burgundy studio mood.
cameraSettings: Canon EOS R5, RF 85mm f/1.2L, 1/160s, ISO 100
lighting: Circular back-projected halo spotlight with warm rim and soft frontal fill

title: Celebrity Paparazzi
prompt: Transform this photo into a candid paparazzi-style celebrity shot. Add blurred photographers with cameras and flash lights in the background, a press crowd feel, dramatic night-time flash photography lighting, slight motion blur on the edges, high-fashion street-style mood, confident walking pose. Keep the main subject's face and outfit from the original photo unchanged.
howToUse: Upload your original photo as an image-to-image reference. Use the prompt to wrap the subject in chaotic paparazzi camera flashes and night atmosphere while preserving exact identity.
cameraSettings: 24mm f/2.8 direct on-camera speedlite flash, 1/160s shutter, ISO 800
lighting: Hard direct camera flash with ambient background crowd strobe flares
